title: Show HN: FablePool – pool money behind a prompt, and Fable builds it in public
summary: FablePool is a platform that enables users to collectively pool money behind prompts or ideas, and then Fable builds those projects publicly in a transparent development process. It combines crowdfunding with open AI development, allowing communities to fund and track the creation of AI-powered projects.
problem_solved: Enables collective funding of AI project ideas while ensuring transparent, public development that the community can follow and support.
why_valuable: Democratizes AI project creation by allowing groups to collaboratively fund and shape what gets built, with full transparency into the development process.
